instruction: Candid studio photograph, close-up shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain white background and blurred purple flowers in the foreground, three women embrace closely. On the left, the woman with wavy light-brown hair (R3) in a white shirt smiles with her eyes closed. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a white top and denim jacket smiles widely. On the right, the curly-haired woman (R1) in a white shirt smiles with her eyes closed. They are in a tight group hug, with the outer two women wrapping their arms around the center woman and leaning their heads in close. The lighting is bright and soft, creating a warm, affectionate mood.
